note: OPENING-TUTORIAL-KEYS-65: the game's message boxes that name a control or announce a window, by the normalized FNV-1a hash of their text (lower case, white space folded; engine/aga/src/aw_tutorial_rules.c AW_TutorialHash; the game's own text is never kept here). Each row's AmiWind text replaces the box's text: {text} is the original text as shown, {key:COMMAND} the key the player has bound to COMMAND now (aw_textdef.c AW_TextBoundKeyForCommand; 'not bound' when none), so a rebound key shows as rebound; winkey:NAME is a window's own bindable key list (aw_key_NAME). The wording and the format were set with the maintainer: one plain sentence of what you got, then one line per action with its key in parentheses in a column at the right (a tab before the key: aw_ui.c AW_UICenteredLinesUpTo draws the part before it at the left inner margin and the key right-aligned), an empty row between the sentences and the actions and one before the button, lines of about 36 characters at most for the 320-pixel box. kind 'once' shows the row the first time in a game only, the original text after it. Rendered into engine/aga/src/aw_tutorial_table.inc by tools/tutorial_texts.py render; tests/test_tutorial_texts.py checks both agree. The key marker is parentheses, decided by the maintainer (12 November 2026): the game font's '[' and ']' are ornaments, not brackets.
